roles/backupdr.admin.title: Backup and DR Admin
roles/backupdr.admin.desc: Provides full access to all Backup and DR resources.

roles/backupdr.alloydbOperator.title: Backup and DR AlloyDB Operator
roles/backupdr.alloydbOperator.desc: Allows a Backup and DR service account to discover and backup AlloyDB clusters.

roles/backupdr.backupConfigViewer.title: Backup and DR Backup Config Viewer
roles/backupdr.backupConfigViewer.desc: Provides read access to resource backup config. Resource backup config has the metadata of a Google Cloud resource that can be backed up, along with its backup configurations.

roles/backupdr.backupUser.title: Backup and DR Backup User
roles/backupdr.backupUser.desc: Allows the user to apply existing backup plans. This role cannot create backup plans or restore from a backup.

roles/backupdr.backupvaultAccessor.title: Backup and DR Backup Vault Accessor
roles/backupdr.backupvaultAccessor.desc: Allows the Backup Appliance permissions to create and manage backups in a backup vault.

roles/backupdr.backupvaultAdmin.title: Backup and DR Backup Vault Admin
roles/backupdr.backupvaultAdmin.desc: Allows the Backup Appliance full administrative control of backup vault resources.

roles/backupdr.backupvaultLister.title: Backup and DR Backup Vault Lister
roles/backupdr.backupvaultLister.desc: Allows the Backup Appliance permission to list backup vaults in a given project.

roles/backupdr.backupvaultViewer.title: Backup and DR Backup Vault Viewer
roles/backupdr.backupvaultViewer.desc: Allows read-only permissions to access backup vault resources and backups.

roles/backupdr.cloudSqlOperator.title: Backup and DR Cloud SQL Operator
roles/backupdr.cloudSqlOperator.desc: Allows a Backup and DR service account to discover and backup Cloud SQL instances.

roles/backupdr.cloudStorageOperator.title: Backup and DR Cloud Storage Operator
roles/backupdr.cloudStorageOperator.desc: Allows a Backup and DR service account to store and manage data (backups or metadata) in Cloud Storage.

roles/backupdr.computeEngineOperator.title: Backup and DR Compute Engine Operator
roles/backupdr.computeEngineOperator.desc: Allows a Backup and DR service account to discover, back up, and restore Compute Engine VM instances.

roles/backupdr.diskOperator.title: Backup and DR Disk Operator
roles/backupdr.diskOperator.desc: Allows a Backup and DR service account to store and manage data (backups or metadata) in Disk.

roles/backupdr.managementServerAccessor.title: Backup and DR Management Server Accessor
roles/backupdr.managementServerAccessor.desc: Grants the Backup and DR management server access role to Backup Appliances.

roles/backupdr.mountUser.title: Backup and DR Mount User
roles/backupdr.mountUser.desc: Allows the user to mount from a backup. This role cannot create a backup plan or restore from a backup.

roles/backupdr.restoreUser.title: Backup and DR Restore User
roles/backupdr.restoreUser.desc: Allows the user to restore or mount from a backup. This role cannot create a backup plan.

roles/backupdr.serviceAgent.title: Backup and DR Service Agent
roles/backupdr.serviceAgent.desc: Grants the Backup and DR Service access to protect Compute Engine instances.

roles/backupdr.user.title: Backup and DR User
roles/backupdr.user.desc: Provides access to management console. Granular Backup and DR permissions depend on ACL configuration provided by Backup and DR admin within the management console.

roles/backupdr.userv2.title: Backup and DR User V2
roles/backupdr.userv2.desc: Provides full access to Backup and DR resources except deploying and managing backup infrastructure, expiring backups, changing data sensitivity and configuring on-premises billing.

roles/backupdr.viewer.title: Backup and DR Viewer
roles/backupdr.viewer.desc: Provides read-only access to all Backup and DR resources.
